steps.title: Understand & focus
steps.description: I use research, product data, and business goals to define the problem, priorities, and what success looks like.

steps.title: Explore & design
steps.description: I explore different directions, weigh trade-offs, and develop the flows, UI, and interactions.

steps.title: Prototype & refine
steps.description: I use AI and code to prototype faster, test with users, and refine the design based on what we learn.

steps.title: Ship & improve
steps.description: I work with engineering to ship the design, then use feedback and data to guide improvements.
